facts.official_name: Puratchi Thalaivar Dr. M.G. Ramachandran Central Railway Station
facts.address: Kannappar Thidal, Periyamet, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600003
facts.platforms: 17 (12 main station + 5 Chennai suburban terminal); this plan shows platforms 7–12 only

helplines.label: Retiring rooms (Chennai Central)
helplines.purpose: Retiring / dormitory room bookings. Email smr@mas.railnet.gov.in.

helplines.label: Rajiv Gandhi Govt General Hospital (Trauma Care)
helplines.purpose: Primary emergency medical and Level-1 trauma hospital directly connected via pedestrian subway across EVR Periyar Salai (equipped with escalators per Southern Railway Keyplan).

sources.name: Southern Railway Central Station Keyplan & RGGGH

helplines.label: Central Station Police & Security Booth
helplines.purpose: On-site Police Booth at the Central Station Bus Stop drop-off circulating area.

helplines.label: Superintendent of Police, Chennai Railways (GRP office)
helplines.purpose: Railway police office line (not an emergency line – use 139 or 112 in an emergency).
helplines.notes: From a third-party forum only – verify with Tamil Nadu Police before publishing.

not_used.reason: Listed as enquiry on erail.in, but railway helplines other than 139/182 were discontinued from 1 Jan 2020 – use 139.
RPF security helpline merged into 139 and withdrawn from 1 April 2021.
Only found as a Maharashtra railway police helpline; no Tamil Nadu source.

amenities.name: Wheelchair Accessible Ramp & Assistance Point
amenities.detail: Designated Divyangjan accessible entrance with step-free ramps located at Main Passenger Drop Zone near Wall Tax Road.

amenities.name: Cloak room
amenities.detail: Luggage deposit for passengers with a valid ticket from this station.

amenities.name: Retiring & dormitory rooms
amenities.detail: Bookable online; see retiring rooms contact.

amenities.name: Restaurants, bookshops, shopping
amenities.detail: Food outlets are drawn on the plan; others are not located.

amenities.name: Passenger enquiry terminals & 7 touch-screen PNR machines
amenities.detail: Locations not shown on the plan.

amenities.name: Parking & Drop Zone
amenities.detail: Dedicated passenger car parking & drop-off zone (south-east).

amenities.name: Prepaid auto & taxi stands
amenities.detail: Government-regulated prepaid counter located at the central circulating drop zone.

amenities.name: Public transport
amenities.detail: 24-hour; Central Station bus stop on Wall Tax Road side; Chennai Central metro station nearby.

amenities.name: Rajiv Gandhi Hospital & Park Station Subway
amenities.detail: Direct pedestrian subway with escalators connecting Central Concourse to RGGGH and Chennai Park Suburban Station.
